decision.title: One Take
tracklist: You Need Me, I Don't Need You (SBTV Version)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (3 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/6634796-Ed-Sheeran-One-Take-EP, https://www.stereoboard.com/content/view/164756/9. 2011 free digital promotional EP (Atlantic) - three one-take recordings. NOT 6 tracks: Discogs (r6634796), Stereoboard UK (Apr 7 2011 contemporary press release), eruce.com and racksandtags all agree on 3 tracks. Discogs entry has a typo 'Wayfarer Stranger'; correct title per press is 'Wayfaring Stranger'. 'U.N.I.' became a track on '+' (2011).
